verdict.rationale: Hugging Face documents Inference Providers as a drop-in replacement for the OpenAI chat completions API where you just swap the base URL. One docs line implies a guide for pointing a tool at Inference Providers with a single HF token, but the pack never names which coding agents or agent frameworks get first-party integration guides. Missing for 10: named first-party integration guides for specific coding agents and agent frameworks, step-by-step configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of those integrations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides

citations.quote: Point it at Inference Providers to run [the latest open models available](https://huggingface.co/models?inference_provider=all) with a single Hugging Face token.
Drop-in replacement for the OpenAI chat completions API.
Just swap-out the base URL to instantly access hundreds of additional open-weights models through our provider network.
